label: mimo-v2.6-pro
rule: state within and 7+ nights (the check_before_route rule); allowed endpoints ordered by blended price, cheapest first
usage: Put openrouter.provider in the request body. Fallbacks stay on and move only among the allowed endpoints. An account-wide allowed providers list in OpenRouter settings also applies; if the two do not overlap, requests fail.
footer: Numbers against a stated reference. Not a claim about intent.
